steps.what: Locate current work orders for the assigned machine and job
Read production specifications and clarify missing or conflicting instructions

tasks.design: Configure a job-linked released-order view in {OPS_SYSTEM}, retaining the authoritative document in {DOCS}. The operator still checks job identity, reads the full specifications and resolves unclear requirements.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right released revision can be separate from understanding its requirements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job and document links can reduce retrieval without interpreting machine settings.
tasks.still_hard: Units, material differences and conflicting or incomplete specifications.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when the instruction does not fit the actual job.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less order retrieval; reading and production judgement remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native job-document links can reduce retrieval effort; this proposed split and saving are unmeasured model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is retrieving and reading instructions, excluding order authoring, machine setup and physical production.

The planner produces job identifier, assigned machine, released revision and document link in existing work-order release. Additional link and revision maintenance is counted as other-role work; no free interpreted production settings are assumed.

The operator captures or scans the assigned job identifier and checks machine and revision during the retained half of s1. Missing or inconsistent links require manual retrieval and clarification; s2 retains all actual specification reading.
Test native released-order views before custom code; existing automatic retrieval earns no new saving.
unknowns: Current retrieval time and released-document controls
Availability of reliable job and machine identifiers
research_questions: Does a native job link reduce retrieval after identity and revision checks?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gross10 minus4 upkeep gives net6. Range0-2 allows existing direct links or paper-at-machine provision to leave little retrieval saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less order searching where job links are missing today; full responsibility for understanding instructions remains.
reach: Coordinate revision clarity with production planning
role.ambitious_version: An operator with easier access to authoritative instructions and unchanged production judgement.

job.title: Crushing, Grinding, and Polishing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
